column1: # CERTA's full certification against the slow but reliable mappers, galaxy (2026-10-22): Ampere Altra, every run pinned to cores 0-63 (taskset), 64 threads; certa-gpu rows add one A100 (device 1). Index loading included; one session per block below.

# CERTA rows: build c9ee1c7 (pass V, adaptive parts), timed on a quiet host, medians of three runs: default; --full-cert --adaptive-parts 0 (passes 3 and L only: the --full-cert of build ea812d8); --full-cert (with pass V); --full-cert --index2 q15. Interval mode, every read a record. The other tools' rows are those of the ea812d8 session (slow_galaxy_ea812d8.tsv; one run each), which do not depend on CERTA's build.
# Short reads: 2,000,000 HG002 NovaSeq X reads (reads/hg002_2M.fq) or pairs; RazerS 3 on the first 200,000 reads / pairs, CERTA timed on the same (data *-200000).

# Settings: CERTA certificate radius <= 5 edits, with pass V <= 12; Yara 1.0.5 -e 4 -y full (every alignment with <= 4 % errors, i.e. 6 edits at 150 bp); RazerS 3 3.5.12 -i 96 -rr 100 (100 % recognition of matches with >= 96 % identity; pairs -ll 450 -le 400). RazerS 3's paired mode aborted (std::bad_alloc, exit 134) at the end of the run, also with -le 150 on 20,000 pairs and again on 2026-10-22 afternoon: its row is the time to the abort.

# HiFi: 242,534 HG002 HiFi reads (hifi_1x.fa). CERTA's long-read pipeline is minimap2 2.31 -x map-hifi + tools/lr_ceiling --certify (OPT proven for 226,330 reads, 93.32 %); Winnowmap 2.03 -x map-pb -W (meryl k = 15, distinct > 0.9998) indexes the FASTA in every run (88.5 s of its 610.4 s; its dumped index crashes on load). lr_ceiling on Winnowmap's alignments is a check of them, not part of a pipeline (slow_hifi_and_logs.txt).
# Scripts: bench/slow_bench.sh (sections certa; the 200,000-read CERTA rows by its razers section's commands), indexes bench/slow_index.sh. Certified shares: slow_certified.tsv.
